gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and submitted scores are not used.
gre_general.quote: Submitted scores will not be used in admission decisions.

supervisor.value: You must find and secure your own faculty advisor as part of the application process (before, during or after submitting).
supervisor.quote: Applicants must seek out and secure their own faculty advisor as part of the application process.

funding.value: Funding depends on your qualifications, applicant numbers and available money; contact faculty directly about RAs.
funding.quote: Funding is awarded based on the qualifications of the student, the number of applicants, the amount of available funding, and the number of continuing students receiving support.

entry_route.value: Apply with a BS in mechanical engineering or another engineering, physics or natural-science field.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering OR Bachelor of Science in any other engineering or physics and natural science discipline.

notes: Only assistant, associate and full professors can be advisors. Engineering Mechanics is a separate PhD.
